fact: The DGM published tender 01/2024/DGM on 15 January 2024 for supply, installation and commissioning of an integrated system to receive and visualise Meteosat Third Generation satellite data, closing 26 February 2024.
title: Supply, Installation and Commissioning of an integrated remote sensing system for the reception and visualization of Meteosat Third Generation (MTG) satellite data - 01/2024/DGM
publisher: Direction Générale de la Météorologie (via Bidding Source)
